basic_profile.bio: I'm a 24-year-old surf enthusiast who recently moved to the sunny coasts of California. I work as a freelance graphic designer, which gives me the flexibility to hit the waves whenever the tides are right. I have a deep interest in obscure surf culture and indie films, often blending my love for surfing with my passion for discovering unique art and music. My evenings are typically spent online, exploring new content and connecting with like-minded individuals. I'm currently single and enjoy going to local surf meet-ups to expand my social circle. While I spend a lot of time on Reddit, I'm still getting the hang of the culture and policies here.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a bachelor's degree in Visual Arts, which has fueled my passion for creative media. My knowledge in surfing is mostly self-taught, accumulated through countless hours at the beach and watching surf videos online. I enjoy exploring surf-related content that has an artistic or alternative edge.
